description: Get up to 10 years of quarterly cash position history from SEC XBRL filings (data.sec.gov company-facts). Returns an array of {periodEnd, usd, formType, isAnnual} sorted chronologically. Deduped by period with annual filings preferred over quarterly. Not feature-gated — works for any company with SEC filings.
name: get_cash_history
title: Get 10-Year Cash History
